text:
maria: Kicking off the Launchwire pilot — small PLG funnel experiment combining free credits, onboarding prompt templates, and a short webinar to drive activation. Goal: +10% 7-day retained DAUs for seeded cohort. Need quick sync on routing and messaging. :rocket:

elaine: Love it. Webinar tentatively next Thu 12pm PT. Can confirm if we lock optics + landing copy today. I can draft 3 subject lines and 2 hero CTAs by EOD.

tom: For rollout, let's split traffic: 70% credit-only, 30% credit+promptpack+webinar invite. We should track activation events separately so we can compare unit economics.

ash: Ops: need the routing spec for infra so we can set reserved capacity for webinar surge. Rough estimate of 300 concurrent? if 30% convert to webinar view we might see 60-100ish.

sam: I'll add a canary for the onboarding flow in Console. Quick routing snippet I propose (pseudo):
```
segment: new_users_0-7d
trigger: first_api_call
actions:
  - seed_credit: 100
  - attach_promptpack: starter-templates-v1
  - schedule_webinar_invite: +24h
metrics: first_10_calls, prompt_use_rate, day7_retention
```
Keep it minimal so we don't overwhelm.

elaine: Messaging notes: short copy, emphasize "30-min live demo + prompt templates". Two variations: product-focused and use-case-focused. We'll A/B subject lines and hero CTA.

maria: @growth-bot can you pull a baseline for 7-day retention and avg tokens/use for cohorts in past 30 days? We need cost per activated user to model ROI.

growth-bot: baseline pulled — cohort avg day7 retention: 18.2%, avg tokens/use first week: 2.4k tokens, median LTV (est): $6.40. Full CSV attached in #marketing-assets.

juniper: CS: we'll run a follow-up drip (2 emails) for webinar watchers with prompt examples + "how we built X" mini-guide. That should help prompt reuse.

tom: Measurement: primary = day7 retention lift; secondary = promptpack adoption rate and avg tokens/week. Want a dedicated dashboard in Console named "launchwire_pilot". Sam, can you create it?

sam: Will do. I'll add token/cost per-request breakdown and a toggle to compare credit-only vs full combo. ETA tomorrow morning.

elaine: Landing copy drafts incoming. Also doing a short Loom for the webinar, will put it on the page for those who register but can't join.

maria: Action items:
- @elaine: finalize copy + subject lines (EOD)
- @sam: dashboard + canary (tomorrow AM)
- @ash: reserve capacity and confirm surge numbers (today)
- @juniper: drip content outline (tomorrow)
- @growth-bot: attach baseline CSV to thread and refresh after run starts

maria: Quick check: are we ok with the seeded credit amount? 100 credits (~$X) per user. If not, propose alternate.

elaine: 100 seems fine for test. Could do a 50/100 split to test sensitivity but that adds complexity. Recommend uniform for this pilot.

maria: Cool. We'll proceed uniform. I'll post a short summary for execs after we have dashboards. :white_check_mark:
